Name: WOUND
Main Effect: Your next Weapon Attack that hits will inflict a Wound on the target.

Name: WING CLIP
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is made with advantage, and on a hit the entity’s {{Move}} action cost is increased by 1 Action Point.

If this hits a flying entity, it falls down toward the ground up to 18 meters (60 feet) if possible.

Name: CONCUSS
Main Effect:
If your next Weapon Attack hits, it removes 2 Reaction Points from the target entity.

If this attack hits an entity that you are taking a reaction to, that entity’s current action is cancelled.

When you take Concuss as a reaction, you can make a Weapon Attack as part of the same reaction by paying the standard Action Point cost for the attack.

Name: MOMENTUM
Main Effect:
You coordinate your steps with your strikes to remain mobile on the battlefield.

The next time you take the Weapon Attack action, before or after the attack, you can move a distance equal to your Movement Speed as part of the same action.

If you choose to move before the attack, the announced target must be in range at the end of the movement or the attack fails even if a different target is in range.

Name: RECKLESS
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is made with advantage, and on a hit its damage is Empowered by 1.

The next Attack Roll made against you is made with advantage.

Name: TAUNTING
Main Effect:
You perform a tactical maneuver to draw your opponent’s focus away from your allies.

Your next Weapon Attack is made with advantage.

On a hit, the target has disadvantage on Attack Rolls and skill checks made against targets other than yourself.

Name: REND
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack that hits will inflict 2 Wounds on the target.

If the target was already carrying a Wound, the attack’s damage is Empowered by 1.

Name: DISARM
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is made with advantage.

On a hit, make a {stat} roll {roll} against the target’s Grit. On a success, whatever it was holding lands 3 meters (10 feet) away in a direction of your choice, and it must take the {{Interact}} action to pick the thing up again.

Name: FEINT
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is made with advantage, and the target cannot spend Reaction Points to answer it.

If the attack misses, the Willpower spent on this move comes back.

Name: SWEEP
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is made against every entity within your reach rather than against one of them.

On a hit, the entity is knocked prone.

Name: RIPOSTE
Main Effect:
When an attack made against you misses, you can use Riposte as a reaction.

You make a Weapon Attack against the entity that missed, paying the standard Action Point cost for the attack.

That attack is made with advantage and its damage is Elevated twice.

Name: EXECUTE
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack is a Critical Hit if it hits an entity that is prone, grappled, stunned or carrying a Wound.

Against anything else it is made with advantage and nothing more.

Name: PERFECT FORM
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack cannot miss, and its damage is Elevated once.

You cannot use this move on an attack that is already carrying another Martial Move.

Name: BLEED
Main Effect:
Your next Weapon Attack that hits will inflict a Wound on the target and on every entity within 3 meters (10 feet) of it.

For as long as the target carries a Wound inflicted by this move, it cannot regain Health.
